LanguageData.RMFlow_PitHeld: Held in a pit: it cannot climb out without a ladder.
LanguageData.RMFlow_PitTooBig: In a pit, but too big for this pit: it can climb out.
LanguageData.RMFlow_JumpIntoPitDesc: Jump down into the pit beside them. The fall hurts, and there is no climbing back out without a lowered ladder, a ramp or climbing gear.
LanguageData.RMFlow_JumpIntoPitConfirm: {0} will jump into the pit, take the fall and be stranded down there until there is a way out (a lowered ladder, a ramp or climbing gear). Jump?
LanguageData.RMFlow_LadderNeedsExcavation: Must be placed in a dug pit.
LanguageData.RMFlow_LadderNeedsWall: Must hang on a wall of the pit: a ladder climbs to a shallower square beside it (north, south, east or west).
LanguageData.RMFlow_LadderHangsOnNothing: Hangs on no wall: the square it faces is no longer shallower, so it leads nowhere.
LanguageData.RMFlow_RampNeedsPit: Must be built in a dug pit or a dry pond bed.
LanguageData.RMFlow_RampNotOnLadder: A square holds a ramp or a ladder, not both.
LanguageData.RMFlow_RampMustFaceUphill: Must point uphill at a square 0.5 m to {0} shallower.
LanguageData.RMFlow_RampJoins: Ramp: walks up {0} to the square it faces.
LanguageData.RMFlow_RampJoinsNothing: Ramp: leads nowhere (the square it faces is not 0.5 m to {0} shallower, or ramps are off).
LanguageData.RMFlow_ClimbsSteps: Climbs out of steps up to {0} deep.
LanguageData.RMFlow_LadderToggleDesc: Raise or lower this ladder. Lowered, people climb down into the pit and back up by it, and haulers fetch what lies on the pit floor. Raised, nobody climbs it either way, and anyone down there stays down there. A colonist moves it when ordered: it can be raised from above or below, but lowered only from above. Colonists never move a ladder on their own.
LanguageData.RMFlow_LadderLowerOnlyFromAbove: Can only be lowered from above, and nobody can stand at its top.
LanguageData.RMFlow_LadderLowerTopUnreachable: Can only be lowered from above: cannot reach its top.
LanguageData.RMFlow_LadderRaisedInspect: Slid up onto the rim: nobody can climb down or out.
LanguageData.RMFlow_LadderLoweredPrisonInspect: Ladder down: anyone climbs it but wild animals; prisoners only in a prison break.
LanguageData.RMFlow_LadderLoweredKeysInspect: Ladder down: your people climb; prisoners only in a prison break.
LanguageData.RMFlow_LadderOverWallInspect: Against a wall: whoever stands here climbs over it (one way, wall and both sides open to the sky).
LanguageData.RMFlow_LadderPortableReach: Portable ladder: reaches a wall up to {0} high.
LanguageData.RMFlow_LadderPortableOff: Portable ladders are switched off in the mod settings: it reaches nothing.
LanguageData.RMFlow_LadderPortableShort: Too short for this wall: it lies on the floor and nobody can climb it. Uninstall it, or dig the wall shallower.
LanguageData.RMFlow_LadderPortableTooDeep: Too deep for a portable ladder (it reaches {0}). Build the wall ladder instead.
LanguageData.RMFlow_ClimbsAnyWall: Climbing gear: climbs any pit wall, slowly.
LanguageData.RMFlow_RescueLadderQueued: {0} is stuck in a pit and cannot climb out: a ladder job was queued at the wall.
LanguageData.RMFlow_ClimbOverWallRoofed: roofed (the wall and both sides must be open to the sky)
LanguageData.RMFlow_ClimbOverWallNoWay: no open side to climb from, or too thick
LanguageData.RMFlow_SwaleNeedsExcavation: A swale is laid in a dug channel.
LanguageData.RMFlow_SpikesNeedDrop: Spikes go only at the foot of a sheer drop of {1} or more. The tallest wall over this square is {0}.
LanguageData.RMFlow_GuardrailNeedsDrop: A guardrail goes only on the lip of a sheer drop: some neighbouring square must be at least 1.5 m lower.
LanguageData.RMFlow_CaptureDown: Capture {0} from the edge of the pit
LanguageData.RMFlow_CaptureDownNotHeld: the pit is not holding them
LanguageData.RMFlow_CaptureDownNoPrisonBed: needs a prisoner bed in the pit
LanguageData.RMFlow_CaptureDownNoLip: no reachable edge cell next to them
LanguageData.RMFlow_CapturedDown: {0} took {1} prisoner from the edge of the pit.
LanguageData.RMFlow_DigFindLetterText: {1} turned up {0} while cutting a canal. The land here holds it — dig deeper, or mine the rock it came from.
LanguageData.RMFlow_DigFindMessage: {0} dug up {1} {2} while cutting the canal.
LanguageData.RMFlow_DeepStoneLetterText: {1} dug 2 m or more down and broke through to a deeper layer: {0}. The surface rock here does not show it; deep pits are the only way to quarry it.
LanguageData.RMFlow_PumpModeDesc: Switch between lifting liquid from the water the pump reaches into a tank on its line (touching it, or joined to it by pipe or hose), and running that tank's liquid into a dug channel beside it.
LanguageData.RMFlow_PumpNoTank: no liquid tank touching it or joined to it by pipe or hose
LanguageData.RMFlow_PumpNothingToDraw: nothing beside it the tank can take
LanguageData.RMFlow_PumpTankEmpty: the tank on its line is empty
LanguageData.RMFlow_PumpNoRoom: no dug channel beside it has room
LanguageData.RMFlow_PumpToOutflow: pumped {0} out of an outflow hose end
LanguageData.RMFlow_PumpPouredOutflow: poured {0} out of an outflow hose end
LanguageData.RMFlow_PumpPouredOverflow: the canal is full: {0} spilled over its edge
LanguageData.RMFlow_PumpNoDumpTank: no tank is set to Dump (pouring only drains Dump tanks)
LanguageData.RMFlow_PumpOtherPouring: another pump on this network is pouring
LanguageData.RMFlow_PumpCircle: intake and outflow are in the same water: the pump only moves it round in a circle (move one hose end)
LanguageData.RMFlow_PumpPourNeedsDumpMessage: {0} is set to pour, and pouring drains only tanks whose Job is Dump. Set a tank's Job to Dump to pour it out.
LanguageData.RMFlow_PumpForeign: the channel holds a different liquid
LanguageData.RM_SubsurfaceNoYield: Subsurface: nothing drillable found under this map.
LanguageData.RM_DrillPlaceNoYield: Subsurface: nothing drillable under this map. A drill or bleed well here would never pour anything.
LanguageData.RM_DrillPlaceSpent: Subsurface: this map's reserve is used up and never refills. A drill or bleed well here would never pour anything.
LanguageData.RM_DrillPlaceOff: Drilling is switched off in the Flow Works settings: a drill or bleed well would sit idle.
LanguageData.RM_DrillNeedsOutlet: Needs a dug channel at its outlet — the cell it faces.
LanguageData.RM_DrillLiquidHasNoCanalForm: The liquid below has no canal form and cannot be poured into a channel.
LanguageData.RM_DrillLiquidMismatch: The outlet already holds {0}; this drill's liquid cannot mix with it.
LanguageData.RMFlow_RaidersSetLadders: Raiders of {0} are setting scaling ladders against your trench.
LanguageData.RMFlow_RaidersFillTrench: Raiders of {0} are shovelling a causeway into your trench.
